qualityAnalysis.1_batch004_biggest_problem: Surface diversity and family-label diversity improved, but novelty is still sometimes manufactured by changing setting, medium, or props while reusing the same underlying choice axis. A second issue is 'weird for weird's sake': several items are playful images rather than real dilemmas.
qualityAnalysis.2_semantic_dedup_vs_batch003: Improved materially. Direct planning/spontaneity rewrites and obvious re-skins are less common, but dedup is not solved: this review identifies 16 formal-bank semantic duplicates, 12 rejected candidates in internal semantic clusters, and 5 archetype-saturation rejects.
qualityAnalysis.3_kids_4_6: Improved in concreteness and imagination, but still mixed. Stronger items create a visible consequence or trade-off; weaker items remain cute-object/sensory/action A-vs-B choices. Strict filtering means only 11 direct-PASS questions in this batch add 4-6 usability across all collections.
qualityAnalysis.4_teens_school_self_management: Yes, substantially improved. Teen candidates are now dominated by hobbies, games, culture, media, events, creativity, and social experiences rather than school/self-management. Only one Teen-primary candidate is rejected in this review.
qualityAnalysis.5_adults_routine_productivity: Yes, substantially improved. Adult-primary candidates focus on travel, food, culture, craft, leisure, home experience, and sensory discovery. Two Adult-primary candidates are rejected here.
qualityAnalysis.6_funny_weird_imaginative: The increase is real and many are good, but the label count overstates quality. Strong examples use absurdity to sharpen a trade-off; rejected examples such as 004-007, 004-184, 004-232, 004-248, and 004-279 are primarily novelty/aesthetic preferences.
qualityAnalysis.7_most_repetition_prone_entries: Friends, Couples, Date Night, Family, Birthday Party, and Road Trip remain the most collision-prone because shared-vs-separate, past-vs-future, surprise-vs-certainty, and one-vs-many structures recur easily. Icebreakers are prone to shallow ability-domain and aesthetics choices.
qualityAnalysis.8_families_to_pause_in_next_batch: Pause or sharply limit generic memory past-vs-future, culture/tradition preserve-vs-reinvent, generic skills breadth-vs-mastery, generic Couples shared-vs-separate/planning, and Road Trip one-stop-vs-many-stops constructions.
qualityAnalysis.9_families_to_increase_in_next_batch: Increase strategy, learning, feedback, attention, safe risk, and control. Communication can continue because quality is high, but avoid merely swapping communication modalities.
qualityAnalysis.10_collections_most_worth_replenishing: By projected direct-PASS inventory gap: Friends and Couples (80 each), then Family/Birthday Party/Sleepover (78), Date Night/Icebreakers (77), Road Trip/Party (75), Dinner (74), Classroom (73), and Teens/Adults/Coworkers (71). Kids reaches 101 only if all direct PASS items are formalized; that does not justify relaxing standards.
